verdict.rationale: Shipping is a fair axis for an ecommerce platform like BigCommerce, but nothing in the evidence pack documents live carrier rates at checkout, label purchasing, or shipment tracking. The only related material is a general mention of extending checkout and a Checkout SDK, which are developer building blocks, not the shipping capability itself.

support.subject: As an operations lead, checkout shows live carrier rates and I can buy labels and track shipments from the platform
